desc:
Actually... how old is Eiki? 🤔 If we go by the fact that she was a Jizō statue, then that puts her back around... the Six Jizō set became a thing during the Muromachi period, but the other Jizō statues came around during the **Edo** period.

So that puts her on a relatively younger side – topping at either around 700 or 400 years.
